claims.quote: In general, treatment of intermittent rhinitis is with antihistamines (oral or intranasal).

claims.text: less effective alt: nasal mast cell stabilizers (eg, cromolyn) and intranasal ipratropium (relieves rhinorrhea).
claims.quote: Less effective alternatives include nasal mast cell stabilizers (eg, cromolyn) and intranasal ipratropium, an anticholinergic, which relieves rhinorrhea.
